description: Ministry Of Investment Promotion - The Colombo Port City (Guidelines on the Grant of Exemptions or Incentives to Businesses of Strategic Importance Duty Free operations) The Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act.No 11 of 2021.
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister under the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, establishing legal frameworks and compliance requirements for duty-free operations. It creates new regulatory requirements, specifies operational guidelines, and rescinds previous regulations, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) rather than government personnel/structure changes.
